method: All expected IDs come from successful receipts, with the board root from create_artboard. Parent links are reconstructed from each actual original HTML payload aligned to its createdNodes list, including receipt-backed Frame/Text expansion of padded leaf divs and explicit alignment checks. Current parents come independently from the complete returned tree indentation.
jsx_note: The JSX exporter can inline SVG content without native SVG descendant IDs. Complete native ID/parent accounting uses the independent full tree response.
